summary:
The live-repair and event services returned service-suspension pages instead of the data the dashboard needed. Some requests were also stopped by an automated-traffic challenge, so no repair receipt or SHA-256 proof hash could be produced.
Restore the repair and event services, and allow the test runner through the automated-traffic protection. Rerun only after the repair endpoint returns a successful response, then capture the receipt’s SHA-256 proof hash.

verdict.root_cause: The live-repair and event services returned service-suspension pages instead of the data the dashboard needed. Some requests were also stopped by an automated-traffic challenge, so no repair receipt or SHA-256 proof hash could be produced.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent correctly navigated to the dashboard and clicked “Run live repair,” which triggered the required repair request. That request received a 503 service-suspension response before a receipt could be generated. Clicking the file watcher afterward did not cause the outage or browser closure, although it could not recover the failed repair.
verdict.bug_title: Repair service suspended during receipt generation
